arguments.command:
cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/deps:/workspace/submission python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from harness import run, oracle
N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
rows=[f'icmp,a,0,9,put,L1,1,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}1,echo,,,',
      f'icmp,b,0,9,put,L1,1,0/i2,{N1}2,{N1}2,echo,,,']
data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
job={'version':3,'seed':'demo',
     'leases':[{'id':'L1','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}],
     'services':[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[10],
     'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
     'requests':[{'id':'r1','at':10,'lease':'L1','target':N1+'1','service':'web','group':'g'},
                 {'id':'r2','at':10,'lease':'L1','target':N1+'2','service':'web','group':'g'}],
     'offers':[{'id':'o1','time':11,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','capacity':1,'cost':1,'group':'o','requests':['r1','r2']},
               {'id':'o2','time':11,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','capacity':1,'cost':2,'group':'o','requests':['r1','r2']}],
     'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':1}],
     'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':1}]}
out=run(job)
print(json.dumps(out['plan']))
active={a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']}
print(active, oracle(job,active))
PYEOF
